name: William Bernard Mcguire

birth.place: Plymouth, Luzerne Co., Pa. (FS); Larksville (1927 licence)

death.place: Mountain Top, Fairview Twp, Luzerne Co., Pa.

events.title: Marriage (1)
events.description: Married Mary Marguerite Prout (b. Plymouth c.1906, dau. of James Prout, carpenter, and Bertha Dunn), by Rev. D. W. McCarthy; licence no. 17091 sworn 25 Nov 1927. Groom of 19 Oak St, Wilkes-Barre.

events.title: Marriage (2)
events.description: Married Alice Theressa Brennan (1907-1994) after Marguerite's death in 1934 (FS).

bioAdditions: William Bernard McGuire, Kathryn's uncle, was a 21-year-old laborer at 19 Oak Street, Wilkes-Barre, when he applied to marry Mary Marguerite Prout of Lyndwood, Hanover Township, on 25 Nov 1927; they were married the next day by Rev. D. W. McCarthy, the same priest who married William F. Meier and Florence Pringle in 1926 (S1). His application names his late parents James McGuire, born at Danville, Pa., and Anna Jones, born in England. Marguerite died in 1934; he remarried Alice Theressa Brennan in 1939, and died at Mountain Top in September 1975 (S2; a GenealogyBank obituary index entry is attached there).
